purpose: Teach: 読み書き/本誌/常務/出回っ/既婚/上述/免責/全長

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の読み書きを毎日鍛えろ
lines.en: Ren — practice reading and writing papers every single day.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Mentor's clarity without harshness. Slight pause before the instruction, as if setting a foundation. Steady eye contact. Expectation that this will be heard and done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本誌の最新号に研究紹介が載りました
lines.en: Yes. Our lab's latest research introduction was just published in the journal.
lines.style: Careful precision. Slight lift of pride underneath the formality — he's done something right and wants it noted. Even pacing, respectful distance maintained. Quiet relief in the finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究所の常務との面談を入れろ
lines.en: Ren — set up a meeting with the research facility's managing director.
lines.style: Clean directive. Brief pause after his name, letting the instruction land. No softening, no edge. The tone of someone used to being obeyed because he doesn't ask twice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市場に出回っている類似研究を調査しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already surveyed the similar research that's currently on the market.
lines.style: Eager to prove readiness. Speaks slightly faster than before, wanting to show he's ahead of the curve. Careful enunciation on the research details. Small, professional nod at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、既婚の研究者の事情にも配慮しろ
lines.en: Ren — be mindful of the circumstances of married researchers on the team.
lines.style: Shift to something more human. Still authoritative, but the kind that comes from experience of seeing people break. Slower pace on this one. A gentle firmness, like he's learned this lesson.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。上述の理論を論文の冒頭で扱います
lines.en: Yes. I'll address the theoretical framework I mentioned earlier in the paper's introduction.
lines.style: Nod of understanding. He's tracking the subtle point about care and translating it into method. Controlled, efficient speech. The reassurance that he gets it without needing explanation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の免責事項を論文に明記しろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure to include explicit disclaimers about the research limitations in the paper.
lines.style: Final instruction of the session. Slight deliberation before speaking, as if reviewing a mental checklist. Serious tone. The kind of thing that matters legally and ethically — delivered with that weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料の全長を測定して論文に記載します
lines.en: Yes. I'll measure the full length of all samples and include those measurements in the paper.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Steady, professional. The small relief of reaching the end of the checklist. Voice settles into a quieter register — still respectful, but fractionally less tense than before.
